name: AIMetricValue
description: Renders a single KPI value (e.g. `42.8K`, `78%`, `1.18`) at one of three sizes — sm 24px, md 32px, lg 40px. Tabular numerals + tight letter-spacing keep numbers crisp and aligned. Optional `unit` slot renders inline at 60% of the value size so suffixes like `K` / `%` stay clearly subordinate.
intent: The big number at the heart of every AI Card Metric. Three sizes share one type scale so dashboards stay rhythmic.
